annotations.title: Everything for one destination in one call

description: One call that answers "can I camp at this spot this weekend?": land status and the camping rule, signal per carrier, the 3-day forecast with workable days, wildfires within 60 km, road reports within 10 km, and the best remote spots with signal nearby (top 3 free, 5 with a pass), with the important heads_up lines listed first.

carrier.description: Mobile carrier to rank signal for. Canada: telus (also Bell, Koodo, Virgin), rogers (also Fido), freedom, sasktel. US: verizon, att, tmobile, gci, inland. Defaults to telus in Canada and verizon in the US.

lng.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), negative west of Greenwich.

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometres (default 40, at most 200).

tz_offset_min.description: Minutes from UTC for day boundaries. Default -420.
